sections.text:
Ability Power 190. Damages all enemies 3 times with physical star damage with a success value of 100.
Ability Power boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Increases ATK and MATK of all allies by 30% for 60 seconds.
-Decreases DEF and MDEF of all allies by 30% for 60 seconds (Demerit).
*Activates the following effects if the allied Field has star element cast upon it:
-Recovers 15 Cost for all allies.
-Fills the Unison gauge of all allies excluding yourself by 20.
